title: TypeScript Check Units
description: 🧩️ Cuts a TypeScript program into acyclic check units with declared declaration boundaries. A unit is checked against the declaration output of the units it imports, never against their sources; the output is content-addressed and shared, the incremental compiler state is per session.

seeds.description: Where unit boundaries start before cycles are considered.

markers.description: Directory names whose parent is a unit root (the taxonomy package directory).

manifests.description: A directory with a package.json outside every marker tree is a unit root.

roots.description: Workspace-relative directory globs (`*` per segment) that are unit roots.

isolate.description: Directory names whose files form their own unit per root, so editing them re-checks nothing else.

ambient.description: Workspace globs of global declaration files: owned by no unit, listed in every unit, part of every unit key.

cycles.description: What happens to units that import each other.

collapseFiles.description: A cyclic core with at most this many files becomes one unit.

refineRounds.description: Larger cores are split along their directories for this many rounds; what stays cyclic is collapsed.

minimumFiles.description: Units below this size are merged with siblings when the unit graph stays acyclic; 0 or 1 disables.

forced.description: Compiler options every unit configuration sets on top of the family configuration.

declarationCodes.description: Inclusive diagnostic code ranges that report declaration-emit limits (a type that cannot be named in a declaration file). They are counted as boundary findings, never as check errors.

extraTypes.description: Module specifiers of declaration files added to every unit program (the host resolves them with the compiler's module resolution): global augmentations such as `import.meta.vitest` that the monolithic program received from an unrelated import and a unit program does not.
